metadata.question: Was the NVDI lower in northern Kenya than in southern Kenya during May-June 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search strategy**: - Collection: Sentinel-2 (high temporal resolution, NDVI capable) - Date range: May 1 - June 30, 2019 - Locations: Northern Kenya (e.g., Turkana region, ~3°N, 35°E) vs Southern Kenya (e.g., Tsavo region, ~3°S, 38.5°E) - Use representative geometries for each region 2. **Masking strategy**: - Apply cloud mask (QA60 band) to ensure valid pixels - Calculate NDVI from B4 (red) and B8 (NIR) - Check pixel counts after masking 3. **Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error (C3)**: - If NDVI values are computed and within valid range [-1, 1], proceed to comparison - If either region has 0 valid pixels after masking → C2 - If collection is empty → C1 - If NDVI values are None/NaN → C3 - Compare mean NDVI: if northern < southern → A (Yes), else → B (No) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define regions: Northern Kenya (Turkana) and Southern Kenya (Tsavo) const northernKenya = ee.Geometry.Point([35.2, 3.5]); const southernKenya = ee.Geometry.Point([38.5, -3.0]); const buffer = 50000; // 50 km buffer for region const northGeom = northernKenya.buffer(buffer); const southGeom = southernKenya.buffer(buffer); const startDate = '2019-05-01'; const endDate = '2019-06-30'; // Function to compute NDVI and statistics async function getNDVIStats(geometry, regionName) { let collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(geometry) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 50)); const colSize = await collection.size().getInfo(); if (colSize === 0) { console.log(`${regionName} Images: 0`); return null; } // Cloud masking function const maskClouds = (image) => { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask).divide(10000); }; // Apply cloud mask and calculate NDVI const ndviCollection = collection.map((img) => { const masked = maskClouds(img); const ndvi = masked.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); return ndvi; }); // Check if any valid pixels exist const pixelCount = ndviCollection.first() .reduceRegion( ee.Reducer.count(), geometry, 30, null, null, false, 1e9 ) .get('NDVI') .getInfo(); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log(`${regionName} Valid Pixels: 0`); return null; } // Calculate mean NDVI const meanNDVI = ndviCollection.mean() .reduceRegion( ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry, 30, null, null, false, 1e9 ) .get('NDVI') .getInfo(); console.log(`${regionName} Images: ${colSize}, Valid Pixels: ${pixelCount}, Mean NDVI: ${meanNDVI.toFixed(4)}`); return meanNDVI; } // Get NDVI for both regions const northNDVI = await getNDVIStats(northGeom, 'Northern Kenya'); const southNDVI = await getNDVIStats(southGeom, 'Southern Kenya'); // Validate results if (northNDVI === null || southNDVI === null) { if (northNDVI === null && southNDVI === null) { console.log('No valid pixels in both regions after masking.'); console.log('C2'); } else { console.log('One or both regions lack valid data.'); console.log('C2'); } return; } if (isNaN(northNDVI) || isNaN(southNDVI)) { console.log('NDVI calculation resulted in NaN.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare NDVI values console.log(`Comparison: Northern NDVI (${northNDVI.toFixed(4)}) vs Southern NDVI (${southNDVI.toFixed(4)})`); if (northNDVI < southNDVI) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
